summary: The JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan (Standard) let postdoctoral researchers across multiple fields carry out research with a host in Japan. This listing covers the FY2027 Standard open call, 2nd recruitment round. The application is submitted to JSPS by a host researcher in Japan through the head of their institution.
highlights: For postdoctoral researchers across multiple fields.
FY2027 Standard open call, 2nd recruitment round.
A host researcher in Japan submits the application to JSPS through the head of their institution.
Host institutions may set earlier internal deadlines.
